video_title: Heat To Contend? & MASSIVE Prove-It Year For Teams In The Southeast Division + Our Win Total Draft

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Atlanta Hawks' potential as a top-six Eastern Conference team
quotes.excerpt: The Hawks are a team that has built themselves into a strong contender to be a top-six team.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Hawks are a team that has built themselves into a strong contender to be a top-six team. When I say that, that is not meant to be dismissive.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: There are more good teams in the East than the West now.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Absolutely. The Hawks are set up to be competitive this year, top-six competitive this year, and definitely to be kept an eye on as a trade team this year to make a big acquisition and as a potential cap space team next year.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Atlanta Hawks' poor personnel decisions this off-season
quotes.excerpt: They've made some one very bad personnel decision this off-season.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: You are correct.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I doubt they'll be repeating. They've made some one very bad personnel decision this off-season.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Atlanta Hawks' roster and trade outlook
quotes.excerpt: They have a reasonably strong starting five. A little bit thin at the big man spot.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: They have a reasonably strong starting five: Jalen Johnson, Dyson Daniels, CJ McCollum, Lou Dort, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Onyeka Okongwu. A little bit thin at the big man spot. You are definitely keeping an eye on Kingston Flemings, who they drafted out of Houston. CJ McCollum is obviously going to be their veteran point guard, but I think Flemings, between Flemings and Nickeil Alexander-Walker with McCollum, that's a pretty good three-guard rotation.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: He's a major part of this team, but if he can be a major part of finding a star, then you know, he's untradeable, that's for sure.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Orlando Magic's high expectations and luxury tax situation
quotes.excerpt: They are projected to pay the luxury tax. They have not paid the tax since Dwight Howard was there.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: They are projected to pay the luxury tax. They have not paid the tax since Dwight Howard was there. In their team history, they've paid about 38 million in taxes. This year at the moment, we'll see if it changes, they're projected to pay 32 million in taxes this year. The expectations are that this team is going to be competing because if you're going to be spending that kind of money, this is something the ownership has not done there.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Well, I should have known.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Black's role and potential with the Orlando Magic
quotes.excerpt: Keep an eye on Anthony Black, who was a mid-lottery pick, had a really good year last year.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Keep an eye on Anthony Black, who was a mid-lottery pick, had a really good year last year. Extension eligible, but for all the reasons you just laid out, I don't know that an extension is happening. And if an extension isn't happening, is he a guy who could get moved mid-season? Is that just a situation you deal with in restricted free agency? But look, this is a team that Paolo Banchero is a 25% max guy. By the way, if he'd been all-NBA, he'd be 30%. Franz is a 25% max guy. Bane, they gave up a lot to get Bane in terms of picks, like the Grizzlies got an absolute haul of picks in that deal, and he's a 24% of the cap. So you've got 74% of the cap tied up in three guys. They've got to be star-caliber players, and there was a lot of finger-pointing with the Magic last year. Not necessarily publicly, but it wasn't any kind of secret. There's a lot of finger-pointing at Jamal Mosley.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Charlotte Hornets' roster changes and future outlook
quotes.excerpt: They obviously made the huge move in the off-season, trading LaMelo Ball, bringing in Naz Reid, bringing in Grayson Allen, bringing in Royce O'Neale.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: They obviously made the huge move in the off-season, trading LaMelo Ball, bringing in Naz Reid, bringing in Grayson Allen, bringing in Royce O'Neale, bringing in a couple of first-round draft picks. It seems like they are maybe taking a step sideways to retrofit their roster. They want to invest in Brandon Miller. They're going to try to get him into a contract by Monday, an extension. Obviously, they think a lot of Khan. I'm not sure I don't think they're going to win 44 games again.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I think they assessed what they had last year and it was an extremely exciting last few months of the regular season. They decided, hey, we don't believe in this team as a team that can do any kind of real damage. And they said, actions over words. Our actions say we don't believe in LaMelo Ball as a franchise centerpiece.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's new role with the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: New look Giannis Antetokounmpo wearing number seven now. Looks like a quarterback instead of a running back.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: New look Giannis Antetokounmpo wearing number seven now. Looks like a quarterback instead of a running back.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: No, he still looks like a running back. The running backs wear seven these days too now.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: That's true. That's true. That's more of our our childhood with those numbers.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Drives me. He still looks like a he looks like Derek Henry out there still. I don't care what number he's wearing.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Miami Heat's roster and playmaking limitations
quotes.excerpt: They're not going to be fun to play. Davion Mitchell is an absolute pit bull at point guard.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: They're not going to be fun to play. Davion Mitchell is an absolute pit bull at point guard, one of the best on-ball defenders in the league, and they're going to be tough to score on like you said. They addressed shooting, they addressed shooting with, you know, with aging one-way players, but Clay Thompson can hit open shots. Tim Hardaway Jr. can absolutely be a volume three-point shooter.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: You said they're built around Giannis. I would say they are in the process of building around Giannis, because it took so much to get him that it's still a stripped-down roster.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Washington Wizards' rebuilding strategy and Anthony Davis's future
quotes.excerpt: They are pioneers of, you know what I call the flip. They want to flip this team around.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: They are pioneers of, you know what I call the flip. They want to flip this team around instantaneously. Look, I think if they can get into the play-in, it's a massive step forward. They're adding three impact players: Trey Young at point guard, Anthony Davis at center or power forward, however you want to designate him, and Alex Sarr. But you would have to assume Sarr is going to be coming back from the foot injury. But, you know, eventually they get the two of them healthy, hopefully. That's a formidable front line.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Wait, what about you before? What about number one overall pick DeAndre Ayton?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: True, acquired via the Lakers. Yes, DeAndre Ayton part of. And listen, you know, their big man rotation should be pretty good.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Skepticism regarding Anthony Davis's future with the Washington Wizards
quotes.excerpt: The AD situation, I am an extreme skeptic on. That thing stinks to me.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: The AD situation, I am an extreme skeptic on. This, hey, yeah, we'll talk about it after the season, contractual situation. My BS detector is blaring. AD without an extension when you just gave Trey 213 million dollars is not a great situation. That thing stinks to me. I will be surprised if Anthony Davis is still in Washington after the trade deadline.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Oklahoma City Thunder as a top-tier team
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to go with the team that's had the most wins in the league the last couple of years.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I'm going to go with the team that's had the most wins in the league the last couple of years. I'm really going out on a limb here, and I will take the Oklahoma City Thunder and hope that Jalen Williams in particular can have a healthy season.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: That's a really good pick. I think they are a winning machine.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The San Antonio Spurs' potential and roster strategy
quotes.excerpt: I do think that the Spurs could have a bit of a rocky, not rocky, they could go through an adjustment period.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I do think that the Spurs could have a bit of a rocky, not rocky, they could go through an adjustment period. It does appear that Mitch Johnson is committed to starting the three guards, putting Dylan Harper into the starting lineup. And that to me is a no-brainer. They have to play that way, guys, because they are their three, they are their three or four best players.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: No, they have to play that way because Dylan Harper is too damn good to be satisfied with coming off the bench in his second season.

quotes.speaker: Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jackson's draft picks: Minnesota Timberwolves and Los Angeles Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I will now take the Minnesota Timberwolves with my first selection and then the Los Angeles Lakers.

text_blocks.speaker: Jackson
text_blocks.text: I will now take the Minnesota Timberwolves with my first selection and then the Los Angeles Lakers with my second selection. I am buying what they're selling on the flip, not necessarily on the defensive end, but at this point in the draft, if a team can score some points, they're going to win some games. And they sure want to win games, and you know, I'm a fan of our pod friend and the coach with Will Hardy there.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Boston Celtics' outlook and reliance on key players
quotes.excerpt: I'm not saying the Celtics are falling off. I think the Celtics are going to be a top-four.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I'm not saying the Celtics are falling off. I think the Celtics are going to be a top-six, probably top-four, just assuming that Paul George plays the majority of their games and that they don't miss the production of Jaylen Brown. I don't know man, like that's a lot of faith in some spreadsheets, I would say.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Mazzulla's experimentation with the Boston Celtics' lineup
quotes.excerpt: Joe Mazzulla called Mitchell Robinson one of the smartest basketball players he's ever been around.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Joe Mazzulla called Mitchell Robinson one of the smartest basketball players he's ever been around, and he is experimented in the preseason with playing Nimi Keda and Mitchell Robinson together.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Oh, please. Yeah, a team that wants to shoot 53s per game, please have two non-shooting bigs playing together in the year 2026.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Detroit Pistons' potential and roster changes
quotes.excerpt: I am taking the Detroit Pistons in this spot. I know that the Pistons have their flaws.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I am taking the Detroit Pistons in this spot. I know that the Pistons have their flaws. I think they will be highly motivated after the way last season ended. Jalen Duren looked great in his first preseason game. Looks to be in good shape. I think Cade Cunningham, let's not forget Cade Cunningham finished top-five in MVP last year if I'm not mistaken, even though he was given the free 65th game. That was a whole, I mean look, the poor guy had a lacerated lung. I'm not, I'm just saying that whole thing was weird. I'm not sure that the swap out of Tobias Harris and, beef stew, Isaiah Stewart, losing those two guys and bringing in John Collins and Isaiah Joe, I'm not sure that that swap out is ideal, but I do think that when Cade Cunningham is running pick and roll with Duren and or Collins, that's a formidable thing to stop.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Cleveland Cavaliers' playoff performance and analytical outlook
quotes.excerpt: Cleveland Cavaliers won a lot of regular season games. I don't know what to think of them.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Cleveland Cavaliers won a lot of regular season games. I don't know what to think of them in terms of the playoffs. I mean they did break through and get to the conference finals last year and analytically they did okay for a couple of games, but didn't end up winning any of them.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Memphis Grizzlies' potential and roster concerns
quotes.excerpt: I was pretty impressed with the product that we saw in Macau last week.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I was pretty impressed with the product that we saw in Macau last week. Cam Boozer, I think is going to put up enormous numbers. The GMs picked Cam Boozer, it was not overwhelming, but they picked Cam Boozer to be the favorite to win Rookie of the Year, and I understand that. He's going to put up big numbers. I also want to point out like Ty Jerome, he missed like all of last year. That guy is a player who can make a difference and he's going to help them win some games. Zach Edey is currently healthy. I have no idea whether he's going to stay healthy. That is a guy who causes problems for teams.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Cedric Coward is a good young player. I mean they've got some good they've got some good young players on the roster.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Houston Rockets' late-game struggles and roster potential
quotes.excerpt: I feel pretty good. This is a team that won 52 games last year.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I feel pretty good. This is a team that won 52 games last year, and 17 of the 30 games that they lost, they were in winning position. Look, I think if they can get into the play-in, it's a massive step forward. They're adding three impact players: Fred VanVleet at point guard, Stephen Adams at center, and I think they're going to be a team that's going to be a lot of fun to watch. I think they're going to be a lot of fun to watch. I think they're going to be a lot of fun to watch.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Well, yeah, because it cost them. I mean, I think E-May stat is 17 of their losses they led by double figures.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's consistent performance and shooting efficiency
quotes.excerpt: I want to point out that Kevin Durant last year was not by his standards not a great season.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I want to point out that Kevin Durant last year was not by his standards not a great season. He still shot 52% from the field. He has shot over 50% from the field every year since 2010-11. As a guy who's creating off the dribble a lot and doing a lot of damage with his jump shot. Crazy. And he also shot over 41% on threes last year. It's just crazy.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I mean, he's made 50-40-90 almost ho-hum. It's incredible.

quotes.speaker: Jackson Hoy
quotes.summary_phrase: New Orleans Pelicans' win total outlook after injury-riddled season
quotes.excerpt: trying to take a team that had some success-ish with a roster that was decimated with injuries
quotes.quote: Along the lines with a team last year that won 26 games, hoping for similar-ish, maybe a little better outlook this year with the Pelicans. Their line is at 28.5. So at this point in the draft, trying to take a team that had some success-ish with a roster that was decimated with injuries last year. They have some lanky wings. Can they put together a handful of wins? I'm looking for a team not to have the bottom fall out here at this range.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson's physical conditioning and outlook for the season
quotes.excerpt: he's slimmed down and and looks ready to roll
quotes.quote: They were just here in Dallas, chatted with Jamal Mosley. He's very excited about Zion. Very excited about the way that Zion's been working, the way that he reported to camp, the conditioning he's in. Like every camp, there's a Zion weight update. He's slimmed down and and looks ready to roll. We'll see if that stays that way, but he's given his new coach reason to believe.

quotes.speaker: Jackson Hoy
quotes.summary_phrase: Sacramento Kings' veteran presence and outlook for the season
quotes.excerpt: I'll take the Kings just due to some of the veteran presence still there
quotes.quote: With my final pick, there's not really an option that I like here. I guess as far as other talent, there's a lot of young guards here, which is never a recipe for success. I'll take the Kings just due to some of the veteran presence still there. I don't feel good really about any of these with the young guards, but a coach has been at least, they'll at least be fun to watch.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon's disappointment in missing out on the Kings
quotes.excerpt: I really thought I was going to get the Kings to wrap this up
quotes.quote: I really thought I was going to get the Kings to wrap this up, but all right. In other words, I think you made a bad pick.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon

quotes.quote: He is not played well in the preseason. Well, they only owe him what, like 64 million? I'll take the Nets. I believe Jordi Fernandez, what he's allowed to actually coach, will get some more wins out of them.
